root_cause_criterion.description: In the `force_extensible_wave_format` branch, `decode_file()` must set `output_format = FORMAT_WAVE` before assigning `output_subformat = SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE`. The vulnerable branch leaves the earlier AIFF-C selection intact, while the fixed branch restores the missing `FORMAT_WAVE` assignment before the WAVE-extensible subformat is chosen.

nodes.description: At the raw-output initializer guard, `options.format` is not `FORMAT_RAW`, so the only explicit initialization of `decoder_session.is_big_endian` and `decoder_session.is_unsigned_samples` is skipped on the vulnerable path.

Immediately before the fast-path sink branch, `decoder_session->format` is still `FORMAT_AIFF_C` while `decoder_session->subformat` has already been forced to `SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE`, so the AIFF-C special cases do not match and the fallback reads uninitialized session state.

edges.description: The `output_format` value left in `decode_file()` after the forced extensible-wave branch is copied into `decode_options.format` and arrives at `flac__decode_file()` as `options.format`, determining whether the raw-only initializer runs.

The non-raw `options.format` value propagates into `decoder_session->format` and reaches `write_callback()` unchanged, preserving the stale `FORMAT_AIFF_C` container choice at the sink-side fast-path check.

The forced WAVE-extensible `output_subformat` selected in `decode_file()` propagates through `decode_options.force_subformat` into `decoder_session->subformat`, creating the impossible `(FORMAT_AIFF_C, SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE)` pair observed at the sink.
